lines: Forging my life, passing through as always
The one time I said "I understand," it never came back
It's a conscious crime, right? After I cried during dinner
You were laughing
Saying "I'm the same way," pooling our false feelings together
Spitting it out, staying silent, it just keeps piling up
No matter what, face to face, "goodbye"—
I don't even have the right to say it, and still I
Burrow into the ashes, bite the second hand
In a daydream, I smashed it again and again
But it won't break, it won't stop
Still not knowing the truth, I go on
I want to steal it as it is, hide it, forget it
Even without a single circle of understanding between us
Don't meet me and answer with "I'm sorry," okay?
Words without form, I don't need them
A scar that won't fade: "I'll take anything you give."
I said that once, and I'm never coming back
Even if it was nonsense, even if it wasn't for my sake
You protected me
My eyes, my mouth, to the point they mean nothing
Shut down, unable to move—that me
Don't find me, can't you just leave me be?
Wherever I look, wherever I am, nothing opens
Burrow into my lungs, bite the second hand
In a daydream, I smashed it again and again
But it won't break, it won't stop
If I'm going to keep playing the part
I want to steal it as it is, hide it, forget it
Even without a single circle of understanding between us
Don't meet me and answer with "I'm sorry," okay?
Words without form, I don't need them
Clinging, screaming, there's no morning
Laughing, falling down, pathetic
It's no one's fault
And yet I want to blame someone
Do I even exist?
The truth is, I already know
Even if you give up on me, I'll end up believing
As it is, I want to steal it, hide it, forget it
As it is, I want to steal it, hide it, forget it
As it is, I want to steal it, hide it, talk with you
Even without a single circle of understanding
Don't meet me and answer with "I'm sorry," okay?
"Why me, who only doubts?"
A lie that can't save me—I don't need it
HARETA REIRA
